method.strategy: Current Scalp 1:1, same production filters and split-entry history functions; chart simulations, not a reconstruction of MT5 fills.
method.limitations: Descriptive comparisons, overlapping features and small sample. No causal attribution to news/spread/slippage without broker ticks and archived event timestamps. Post-entry measurements are diagnostic, not pre-entry filters. Prior-swing comparison uses the 8 candles ending before the pattern, not a confirmed pivot. Recovery check requires 8 consecutive completed candles strictly after exit.
method.scope: Only report artifacts written; trading settings/code unchanged.
